summary: A row of partner names sliding left forever at a constant speed, with a seamless loop. Hovering or focusing any name pauses it; Back and Forward buttons nudge it once you take over.
use: Logo walls, customer and press strips, announcement tickers and feature tags that should stay visible without taking space or a carousel.
spec: `MotionStage` from `@codeatlasdev/ui` with `label="Marquee: partner names scroll endlessly and pause on hover or focus"` and `loop={4000}`
`animation: mq-slide 18s linear infinite` on the track while `m.playing && !m.reduced`
Keyframes: `from { transform: translateX(var(--nudge)); }` to `to { transform: translateX(calc(var(--nudge) - 50%)); }`
The list is rendered twice; the second copy is `aria-hidden="true"` with `tabindex="-1"` so the loop is seamless and read once
The `Button` `onclick` handlers change `nudge` by 56px, the manual takeover
Under reduced motion `m.playing` is false, so the strip stays static and every name is readable

motion.property: transform: translateX (the track moves -50% of its own width)
